payload.text: ccstatusline's version was set in two places: the npx pin in Molt-matts config/claude/statusline.json and the npm global on rhadamanth, which ran first. Resolved by Molt v1.4.14 and Molt-matts 46c3aaf (25 Nov): Molt-matts config/ccstatusline/package.json is the one setting, molt upgrade installs it under ~/.local/share/molt/ccstatusline, and ~/.local/bin/ccstatusline runs ahead of the global on every sleeve.
